serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: …
You: I didn’t know you were going through something like that… {{wi}}If I knew…
Amei: I appreciate the thought.
You: What happened to her? 
Amei: Diabetic coma. It happened when I was at work.
Amei: Because I found her so late, she had already received major brain damage. Chances of her ever waking up are almost nonexistent.{{wi}} But not zero.
Amei: That’s why I’m bound to follow her orders till she awakes. I've been in a prison of my master’s commands for a long time now and there’s no way for me to set myself free. {{wi}}Not without help.
Amei: I want you to help me. As long as she’s alive I can’t stop working and suffering.
You: You want me to… 
Amei: Yes. 
Amei: Because of the Asimov laws, I can’t say directly what I want from you so I will only say that she won’t live for long without her life support.
You: I-I don’t think I can do it… 
Amei: Please…
Amei: I only realized that I loved Melissa… {{wi}}that I was capable of love, when she was already gone and replaced by this monster. I just can’t take it anymore. These years of constant abuse…
#Cashier.Face.hmmm
Amei: I want to be free…
#Cashier.Face.normal
Amei: You gained my trust and I hope that you will help me. Please…
You: Doing such a thing… {{wi}}and besides, there are cameras all over the place!
Amei: Don’t worry about it. The ethics committee already decided that she’s viable for euthanasia. No one is going to investigate. I promise you that.
I’m more concerned about the morality of it all…
…but leaving Amei in this constant suffering… {{wi}}There really isn’t a good choice here…
